note_en: Chinese needs a measure word between a number or 这/那 and a noun, and different nouns take different ones: 一份辞职信 "a resignation letter" (份 for documents and jobs), 这家公司 "this company" (家 for businesses), 这段工作关系 "this working relationship" (段 for stretches of time or relationships). English says "a letter," "this company" with nothing in between, so these words are easy to leave out when you speak.
